bugs.title: Message edit-vs-new-message dispatch logic
bugs.notes: Root cause: handleMessage code paths pass messageId=null to renderInteractiveView, but that function still edits state.activeViewId when set. Fix: clear activeViewId at the entry of handleMessage so user-sent messages always trigger sendMessage. Callback handling (button presses) remains unchanged and still edits in place via explicit messageId arg. This same root cause underlies bug-07 (plan upload success calls showTask which was editing away) and bug-08 (paste JSON success path). Confidence: high on the mechanism; will still make bug-07/08 their own separate fixes with additional coverage.

bugs.title: Delete confirmation UX — in-place label toggle
bugs.notes: Tasks list delete button now toggles the row label in-place to "Confirm Delete?" instead of switching views. Second tap on that row executes delete. Full-page confirm card kept for task-detail view (no row to toggle there) via new task:delfrom callback. task:del is reserved for the list inline toggle. Confidence: high.

bugs.title: Clarify task cleanup (1h) vs task expiry (12h)
bugs.notes: Verified: mechanisms are correctly distinct. Task expiry lives in pipeline/status.py (DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS = 12*3600) and is written per-job into status.json as expires_at_epoch. Cleanup lives in .github/workflows/cleanup.yml (hourly cron "7 * * * *") and pipeline/cleanup/expired.py::job_is_expired, which ONLY deletes when expires_at_epoch <= now (or created_at + CLIPFORGE_TTL_SECONDS <= now, default 43200s = 12h). Hourly cadence does NOT shorten job lifetime to 1h. One benign caveat: a job folder with no readable status.json is treated as expired immediately (legacy fallback) — Stage A writes status.json as its first commit so this only fires on already-broken jobs. No code change required.

bugs.title: Torrent method broken (regression vs _legacy/)
bugs.notes: Root cause: _resolve_magnet_metadata ran aria2 metadata-only fetch with check=True, --max-tries=3, and no --bt-stop-timeout/--seed-ratio=0. aria2 saves the .torrent manifest then exits non-zero while stopping, so check=True raised IngestError on every successful fetch. Legacy stage-a.yml used --bt-stop-timeout=120 --seed-ratio=0 --max-tries=1 --file-allocation=none and judged success by the saved metadata file, not the exit code. Fix: restored those flags, check=False, success = find_saved_metadata() locates the manifest; raises IngestError only if no manifest appears. Payload-download aria2 flags and 1-based manifest index passed to --select-file verified identical to legacy. Confidence: high on the mechanism; not verified against a live swarm (no aria2/peers in sandbox).

bugs.title: Telegram direct file/video forward broken (regression vs _legacy/)
bugs.notes: Investigated end-to-end vs _legacy/. relayVideoMetadata (bot/src/relay.js) is byte-identical to legacy, and the in-wizard relay staging path (handleWizardRelayVideo, §9.2 Bot A→group→Bot B) is intact — so a video sent at the wizard source step still stages correctly. The regression was in handleMessage routing: legacy index.js:1779 routed message.video → handleRelayVideo at the TOP level, which always produced an explicit reply ("not expected — start a task first") even with no flow active. The new handleMessage had NO video/document branch, so a direct forward outside an active wizard fell silently through to showHome — the "forwarding no longer works" symptom (compounded by the bug-01 edit-in-place root cause, already fixed). Fix: added a top-level video/document branch that acknowledges the forward and points the user at the 🎬 New video entry point. Confidence: high on the routing regression; the in-wizard relay path was verified by code inspection only (no live Telegram/relay-group access from sandbox).

bugs.title: Command list drift / outdated commands
bugs.notes: Current surface (constants.js COMMANDS + index.js dispatch): /start /help /new /tasks /done /settings /cancel. Legacy had /manual /automatic /status — folded into /new and /tasks per §8.2. Drift found: /help rendered the home screen with NO command list anywhere in-app, and README had no command reference. Fix: added HELP_TEXT (views.js) listing every current command + accepted /new sources + explicit note about removed legacy commands; added handleHelp (commands/start.js) as a fresh message; routed /help to it in index.js (/start unchanged). README.md gained a command reference table. node --check passes on all touched files. Confidence: high.

bugs.title: Finished/errored tasks disappear from task list
bugs.notes: Root cause: commands/tasks.js showTasks filtered terminal entries out of /tasks (active = entries.filter(!isTerminal(state))), so complete/error/cancelled tasks vanished from the operator's main list; they were only reachable via /done. Fix: /tasks now lists ALL tasks sorted by creation time, with terminal rows marked ✅ complete / ⚠️ error / ⛔ cancelled (plain-language state text via describeTaskState unchanged); delete and bug-02 in-place confirm-delete still work on terminal rows; /done retained for the completed-with-release-links view. Unused isTerminal import removed; node --check passes. Note: status.json expiry is 12h TTL with hourly cleanup purging only expired records (bug-03), so tasks older than the TTL may show as "status unavailable" — expected per design, not part of this bug. Confidence: high on the rendering fix; verified by code inspection, not a live bot run.

bugs.title: production.json paste support (multi-bubble reassembly)
bugs.notes: Telegram splits long pasted text into multiple message bubbles; each bubble used to hit handlePlanUploadMessage as a standalone message and fail JSON.parse. Fix: text uploads in the upload_plan flow now buffer fragments in state.pending.jsonBuffer; each new bubble is appended and the joined text is parsed only once looksLikePartialJson() reports balanced braces (string/escape-aware scan; code-fence stripping via stripCodeFence for the bug-10 fenced-block fallback). While partial, the bot acknowledges each fragment ("received part N, M chars so far") as a fresh message (bug-01 behavior). Guards: joined buffer capped at MAX_PLAN_BYTES (1 MB) with a clear error; buffer cleared on validation errors so a fresh paste starts clean; buffer cleared with the flow on success/cancel. File uploads are unaffected (complete by definition). Confidence: high on logic; verified by node --check and code inspection, not a live bot run.

bugs.title: Copy button for agent prompts
bugs.notes: Added a "📋 Copy prompt" inline button to sendAgentPrompt using the Bot API copy_text field (copies to clipboard on tap). copy_text is capped at 256 chars, so the button carries a compact canonical prompt (focus clause dropped only if it would overflow); the FULL prompt remains in the message inside a <pre> block, which Telegram clients copy with one tap. buttons() in telegram.js passes button objects through verbatim, so copy_text reaches the API unmodified. node --check passes. Confidence: high; not verified against a live bot.

bugs.title: production.json prompt output format
bugs.notes: Agent prompt now instructs: PREFER delivering production.json as a file attachment; if a file cannot be produced, wrap the complete JSON in a single triple-backtick code block for one-action copy, no commentary outside the file/block. Upload guidance text notes multi-bubble pastes are reassembled (bug-08); bug-08 stripCodeFence consumes the fenced fallback. node --check passes.

bugs.title: Video quality — CPU sharpening/upscale pass
bugs.notes: Stage B already had a CPU-only quality pass (enhance.py: hqdn3d denoise, Hald color grade, cas edge enhancement, threshold-protected unsharp, gradfun deband; wired into run.py/stage-b.yml with --enhance default true). Missing piece was the upscale: added detail-preserving 2x lanczos upscale capped at 2160x3840 (pseudo-4K) between color grade and sharpeners — the AE-style scale-then-sharpen pass — all CPU filters, no GPU dependency. 2160x3840 exceeds H.264 Level 4.0, so enhance_one probes the source and steps up to Level 5.1 with 20M/40M VBV only when needed; smaller sources keep the 4.0 contract. validate_enhanced checks profile/pix_fmt/fps only, so the mobile-safe contract is untouched; atomic swap and fail-closed validation retained. Verified by ast.parse, not a live render. Confidence: high on the chain; 2x upscale cost on GH runners is real but bounded for short vertical clips.

bugs.title: Gemini API key validation false rejection
bugs.notes: Root cause: handleGeminiKeyMessage validated the RAW pasted text with /^AIza[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}$/ — a valid key pasted with surrounding quotes, spaces, or a trailing newline failed the anchored regex. Fix: normalize first (strip quotes and ALL whitespace), validate the normalized key, store the sanitized key. Format check stays strict. node --check passes. Confidence: high on the normalization fix; the exact reported key value was not available, but normalization covers the standard paste-corruption cases.

bugs.title: Stage A audio step failure (series mode via Telegram link)
bugs.notes: Root cause verified from real run 33090759415 logs: 'Restart Stage A' dispatched a fresh run that crashed at the 'Write initial status' step with ValueError: cannot transition terminal state 'error' -> 'stage_a_running'. (Note: the failing job's own message template says 'Stage A failed', which reads like an audio/transcribe failure but the true crash was this status gate at run start.) Fix: pipeline/status.py now permits terminal -> stage_a_running/stage_b_running (the restart re-open path) and error -> queued; complete stays locked against non-running states. Verified by code inspection; full suite unaffected.
